name: Training Ray Batching
aliases: Random Ray Batching for NeRF Training
definition: A data loading strategy where random rays are pre-computed for all training images, concatenated with their target RGB colors, shuffled, and then sampled in batches (N_rand rays) per optimization iteration to train the NeRF network.
summary: Training Ray Batching reduces GPU memory by randomly sampling subsets of rays per iteration, distinguishing itself by explicitly managing ray tensor shuffling and slicing across multiple images.
